# ML_flux/ml_silentGC

Data and R script to calculate GC content at silent sites, whereby to bin genes and calculate ML flux differences of bins. 

Steps:
0. Unzip homo_cds_5162.zip

1. Use silentGC.Rmd to calculate silent site GC of each protein-coding gene in the human genome (run line by line)
	Input	files in homo_cds_5162/ 
	Script	silentGC.Rmd
	Output	5162_silentGC.csv 

2. Split 5162_silentGC.csv into three files with an equal number of genes each ("high", "mid", and "low" .tsv files, created via 5162_silentGCbins.xlsx

3. Calculate ML amino acid frequencies as usual for each bin (results in silentgc_ns.csv)

4. Analyze data using silentGC.Rmd
